def get_basic_announcements(announcements: List[Dict[str, Any]], include_local: bool=True) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:

def get_basic_announcements(announcements: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    include_local: bool=True) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Get basic announcements, excluding primary announcements.
    
    Args:
        announcements (List[Dict[str, Any]]): The list of announcements.
        include_local (bool): Whether to include local announcements.
    
    Returns:
        List[Dict[str, Any]]: The filtered announcements.
    """
    # Filter out primary announcements
    basic_announcements = [announcement for announcement in announcements 
                          if announcement.get('type', '').lower() != 'primary_announcement']
    
    # Add local announcements if requested
    if include_local:
        ctx = SafetyContext()
        if ctx.local_announcements:
            basic_announcements.extend(ctx.local_announcements)
    
    return basic_announcements
